summary: Re-verified HR → Müqavilə → Vəzifə Input→Select conversion. Fix IS applied and working (main agent correct; iteration_75 was false negative). Position field is now a Select with data-testid='employee-position-select', placeholder 'Vəzifə seçin', options driven by /api/options/all.positions. Settings ↔ HR sync (add) verified end-to-end. Discovered ONE UNRELATED code deviation from main agent's claim and TWO pre-existing bugs.

minor.issue: When first custom position is added, GET /api/options/all returns ONLY the custom entries (seeded 6 defaults disappear). Behavior: defaults are returned only when the collection is empty; adding one custom entry replaces the whole default list from the user's perspective. Confirmed via API. May be intended, but conflicts with review request expectation that adding TEST_QA_Manager would leave the 6 defaults intact.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking delete on a position item did NOT remove it via UI (item persisted after click; no confirmation dialog appeared and no DELETE request observed). Had to delete via API (/api/settings/positions/{id} DELETE works fine). Likely relies on window.confirm() which Playwright auto-dismisses, but the flow should be re-verified manually.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If legacy-value handling is truly desired (per main agent's claim), update HR.jsx line 1062 to merge formData.position into the options list, e.g.: {[...new Set([...(options?.positions||[]), formData.position].filter(Boolean))].map(p => <SelectItem key={p} value={p}>{p}</SelectItem>)}. Currently code is: (options?.positions || []).map(p => …) — no union with formData.position. Radix Select will show placeholder instead of the legacy value when editing an employee whose position was removed from Settings.

OPTIONAL (pre-existing): Investigate Settings position delete button — either add data-testid on the trash icon and confirm dialog, or replace window.confirm with an in-app AlertDialog for reliable UI delete.
OPTIONAL (pre-existing): Decide whether adding a custom position should keep the default 6 as merged fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: HR.jsx line 1058-1064: Select conversion is correct and clean. However, the main agent's summary claimed the SelectContent merges formData.position with options to gracefully handle legacy positions — this is NOT in the code. The array is just `(options?.positions || []).map(...)`. Not a blocker for the primary fix (Input→Select conversion) but worth noting if edit-mode legacy support is a requirement.
No hardcoded position lists remain in the modal (verified: input#position count = 0).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for position Select fix; 1 pre-existing UI bug found in Settings delete

seed_data_creation: Created + deleted TEST_QA_Manager position via UI (add) and API (delete). No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary fix (HR position Input→Select) is verified working. Options are correctly loaded from /api/options/all.positions. Add flow syncs Settings→HR live (open modal after Settings change → new option appears). Edit-mode legacy value handling NOT implemented in current code despite main agent's claim — flag if that scenario matters. Full employee save was blocked in my run by missing 'Cins' (gender) and 'Şəxsi telefon' fields on Şəxsi tab — that's a test-script gap, not a position-Select regression.

verified_facts.settings_add_sync: Adding TEST_QA_Manager in Settings → appears in HR position select instantly on next modal open
